provenance: Shape from the schema line quoted in chat.html's handler — 'Every live background task after the change. REPLACE semantics: swap your set for this payload.' The REPLACE rule is the whole point of the fixture: merging would leave a finished task on the roster forever.

steps.note: two tasks open the roster chip
a smaller payload REPLACES, it does not merge

empty payload hides the chip — computed display, not the hidden property: manual-test 7.3 was exactly the case where hidden=true yet .chip-btn{display:inline-flex} kept the chip (and its pulsing dot) rendered, and the property assertion could never catch it

expect.why: and ACTUALLY not rendered (7.3 regression pin)
an open roster must not outlive its last task
